liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rain** (2 reviews): Band played three Rain songs to honor attendees who braved the awful weather [15][16]
- **Let the Good Times Roll** (1 review): Vince's performance is described as god awful, ruining the opening song [14]
- **Peggy-O** (1 review): Reviewer notes a rocking Peggy-O in the first set and a nice Rain [13]
- **Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad** (1 review): Performance swings along with a shuffle rhythm, possibly using an acoustic simulator effect [18]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the Drums/Space jam as plain awesome and worth listening to [12]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Review calls the performance a masterpiece, noting the Beatles snippet is groovy [8]

## The recordings

- **gd94-03-28.aud-sbd.unknown.17263.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 149 min; rated 3.76/5 by 17 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording is treble-heavy with little bass, sounding shrill due to Cutler's early mixing; Jerry's guitar sounds more robust and less twangy than on most 1994 tour nights [11][12]
- **gd94-03-28.naks.neo_levo.14261.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 149 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is boomy with distant vocals, though overall quality is fair to good [14]
- **gd1994-03-28.senn441.lynch.34561.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [5]
- **gd1994-03-28.fob.schoeps.cubby.larson.27057.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 154 min [6]
- **gd1994-03-28.137898.set2.sbd.larson.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 86 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [7]

## Around the show

- Weather outside Long Island was pretty crappy during the final Spring tour night [13]
- Fierce, brutal, cold driving rain fell on the final Spring run night at Nassau [15]
- Fierce, brutal, cold driving rain fell on the final Spring run night at Nassau [16]
- Reviewer attended with brother in excellent seats; crowd was surprised by He's Gone energy [19]
- Reviewer ranks it among the best recent shows, though not matching 11-1-85 [8]
- Reviewer claims March 27 was the biggest night of the tour run [9]
- Band mixed up the setlist on the last night of the five-night Nassau run [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-03-28.aud-sbd.unknown.17263.sbeok.shnf**: source: Set 2: mixed DSBD, FM>DAT, AUD B&K (see info file for specifics) [1]
- **gd94-03-28.naks.neo_levo.14261.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by JABUZZ420; source: Audience: Unk Nakamichi's [2]
- **gd1994-03-28.senn441.lynch.34561.flac16**: taped by Dan Lynch (Thanks to Danny Hupert for the patch!); transferred by Dan Lynch; source: Sennheiser 441's > Sony D-7 > DAT Master [5]. Also: Recorded, extracted, and edited by danlynch as part of his Master Series [5]
- **gd1994-03-28.fob.schoeps.cubby.larson.27057.shnf**: taped by Ace Cubby; transferred by Chris Larson; source: fob(in hat) Schoeps mk4>Reutelhuber p/s>Sony tc-d10 proII (modified) [6]. Also: Thanks to Carrion Crow for the DAT source of this recording [6]
- **gd1994-03-28.137898.set2.sbd.larson.shnf**: taped by unknown; transferred by Chris Larson; source: Set 2 Source: SBD:D>ZA2>CD or SHN [7]. Also: Set 2 SBD recording includes Rain through Brokedown Palace, with specific jam transitions [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Nassau Coliseum Subway Poster 1994 #2/30 | #138056166](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-nassau-coliseum-subway-138056166) [21]
